# Dirt

<a href="Item-dirt.md" title="Dirt"><img src="icons/2.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Dirt"></a>

A common building block and the base material for farmland.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Dig dirt or grassy ground with your hands; a shovel makes digging faster.

## Using it

Use a [hoe](Item-wood-hoe.md) on exposed dirt or grass to make [Farmland](Item-farmland.md).

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
